# Kumo Sushi Lounge

> Kumo Sushi Lounge is located at 777 White Plains Rd. and offers a diverse menu of fresh sushi, sashimi, and specialty rolls, alongside a selection of Japanese kitchen entrees such as teriyaki and tempura.

## Menu
KUMO Sushi Lounge offers a diverse menu of fresh sushi, sashimi, and specialty rolls, alongside a selection of Japanese kitchen entrees such as teriyaki and tempura.
